import sys
import threading
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    import sys

    sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    N, T = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    A = []
    B = []
    for _ in range(T):
        x, y = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
        A.append(x)
        B.append(y)

    scores = [0] * N
    freq = defaultdict(int)
    freq[0] = N  # everyone starts at 0
    unique_score_count = 1

    for i in range(T):
        p = A[i] - 1  # 0-based index
        add = B[i]
        before = scores[p]
        after = before + add

        # decrease freq of "before" score
        freq[before] -= 1
        if freq[before] == 0:
            unique_score_count -= 1

        # increase freq of "after" score
        if freq[after] == 0:
            unique_score_count += 1
        freq[after] += 1

        scores[p] = after

        print(unique_score_count)

threading.Thread(target=main,).start()
